invariants.statement: One canonical implementation per business rule; never re-implemented per client or layer.
Every canonical state mutation follows the registered state machine in contracts/v1/states.

enforcement.mechanism: reference UI dispatcher validation + contract validator

invariants.statement: Every mutation is authorized server-side against principal, purpose, and scope.
Draft/prepare/assess never triggers send/share/publish/apply without recorded approval.
The UI is never the authority for domain state, authorization results, or policy eligibility.
AI has no self-granted commit authority over canonical state or external effects.

enforcement.mechanism: ai_function_registry commit_authority=none checked by contract validator

invariants.statement: Provenance and epistemic status are never dropped, flattened, or silently upgraded.
Enums, schemas, policies, actions are defined once in canonical contracts and derived everywhere else.
No unreachable feature without owner + removal condition; feature flags carry full metadata; abstractions need two concrete use-cases.
Deny-by-default and least privilege on every boundary.
Purpose/sensitivity scoping on every data flow; retention/deletion honored.
Regression budgets mandatory once baselines exist (GATE-P3); ratchet thereafter.

enforcement.mechanism: perf ratchet CI (P3 baselines -> P12 enforcement)

invariants.statement: WCAG 2.2 AA target on all candidate-facing surfaces.
Failure modes and recovery paths are designed and tested before production exposure.
Every material operation is traceable end-to-end.
Every schema/data change ships with tested migration and rollback.
No green-by-mock: critical boundaries are verified against real contract behavior.

items: Contract satisfied: every touched semantic maps to contracts/v1
Business invariants preserved (INV-01..INV-17 reviewed where relevant)
No unauthorized new semantics invented locally
Security reviewed with threat-model delta where applicable
Privacy classification handled for new fields/flows
Tests added or updated for new behavior
Semantic conformance green (contract validator + program validator)
No new orphan/dead code; no undocumented flags
Performance regression checked against budgets once they exist
Observability included for material operations once platform exists
Failure/degraded behavior handled, not just happy path
Docs/ADR updated if decisions were made
Migration/rollback handled when persistence or API shape changed

feature_flag_schema.rule: Permanent flags are forbidden; missing metadata fails validation.
